item.title: Sony Boss Reveals Shocking Reason SPIDER-MAN: NO WAY HOME Was Barred From China Release
item.description: Sony Pictures CEO Tom Rothman has elaborated on China barring Spider-Man: No Way Home release in China in 2021, and talks more about the studio's ongoing partnership with Marvel Studios.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery Is Officially Reviewing Paramount's Sweetened Bid For The Company
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery has confirmed that it's officially reviewing Paramount Skydance's offer for the company, putting the previously agreed-upon $82.7 billion deal with Netflix at risk.

item.title: Sony Boss Confirms Live-Action SPIDER-VERSE Will Be Rebooted After Previous Box Office Flops
item.description: Sony Pictures CEO Tom Rothman has confirmed that the live-action Spider-Verse will be rebooted after Kraven the Hunter flopped, and opens up on Marvel Studios' Multiverse Saga struggles.

item.title: MARVEL'S WOLVERINE: Insomniac Reveals Official Release Date For Upcoming Video Game
item.description: Insomniac Games has announced the official release date for Marvel's Wolverine, and we can expect Logan to claw his way onto consoles before Grand Theft Auto 6 this November.

item.title: MONARCH: LEGACY OF MONSTERS Season 2 Reviews Surface As Early Rotten Tomatoes Score Is Revealed
item.description: With the first reviews counted for now in for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 2, an early Rotten Tomatoes score has been generated for Apple TV's MonsterVerse series.

item.title: THE DARK KNIGHT Star Christian Bale Confirms Role In Michael Mann's HEAT Sequel Alongside Leonardo DiCaprio
item.description: Though he didn't reveal which character he'll play in the movie, Christian Bale has confirmed that he will star in Michael Mann's Heat sequel...

item.title: BATMAN: Paul Anthony Kelly Responds To Fan Support For Him To Play The DCU's Dark Knight
item.description: Love Story star Paul Anthony Kelly has emerged as a strong fan-favorite to play Batman in the DCU, and the actor has now responded to the growing support he's seen online...

item.title: DEADPOOL Star Ed Skrein Takes Over Baldur Role In Prime Video's GOD OF WAR TV Series
item.description: Ed Skrein is no stranger to playing a villain, and he's just been added to the cast of Prime Video's God of War TV series as the villainous Baldur, a major threat to Kratos and Atreus.
